```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Process data

```{r}
data_full <- read.csv("data/rotation.csv")
```

```{r}
data_filtered <- data_full %>%
  filter(run <= 10, iteration > 3000,
         orientation_degrees %in% c(0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315))

orientation_list <- unique(data_filtered$orientation_degrees)
node_id <- colnames(data_filtered[,1:250])
sim_id <- c(1:10)
```

```{r}
n_windows=25

avg_embeddings <- data_filtered %>%
  mutate(window = cut(iteration, breaks = seq(min(iteration, na.rm = TRUE), max(iteration, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         length.out = n_windows + 1), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(window, orientation_degrees, run) %>%
  summarise(n_obs = n(), across(all_of(node_id), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(node_id), names_to = "node", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(orientation_degrees = factor(orientation_degrees))
```


# Drift

```{r}
orientation_combs <- expand.grid(f1=orientation_list, f2=sim_id)

degree_similarity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(orientation_combs)), function(row){
  subset <- avg_embeddings %>%
    filter(orientation_degrees==orientation_combs[row,1],
           run==orientation_combs[row,2]) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value)
  
  windows <- subset$window
  x <- as.matrix(subset %>% ungroup() %>% select(!c(window,orientation_degrees,run,n_obs)))
  n <- nrow(x)
 
  pairs <- combn(n,2)
  r <- apply(pairs, 2, function(p) {cor(x[p[1], ], x[p[2], ], method = "pearson")})

  data.frame(label=orientation_combs[row,1],
             sim=orientation_combs[row,2],
             window1=pairs[1,],
             window2=pairs[2,],
             cor=r)
}))
```

```{r}
degree_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=window1, y=window2, fill=m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "Pearson's r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"))
```


## Cross-embedding corr
```{r}
cross_combs <- combn(orientation_list, 2, simplify = FALSE)

cross_similarity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cross_combs, function(pair) {

  do.call(rbind, lapply(sim_id, function(s) {

    token1 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(orientation_degrees == pair[1], run == s) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(window)

    token2 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(orientation_degrees == pair[2], run == s) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(window)

    x <- as.matrix(token1 %>% ungroup %>% select(!c(window, orientation_degrees, run, n_obs)))

    y <- as.matrix(token2 %>% ungroup %>% select(!c(window, orientation_degrees, run, n_obs)))

    # vectorized correlation
    x_centered <- x - rowMeans(x)
    y_centered <- y - rowMeans(y)
    
    x_norm <- x_centered / sqrt(rowSums(x_centered^2))
    y_norm <- y_centered / sqrt(rowSums(y_centered^2))
    
    pearson <- x_norm %*% t(y_norm)

    # store
    expand.grid(window1 = token1$window, window2 = token2$window) %>%
      mutate(label1 = pair[1], label2 = pair[2], sim = s, cor = as.vector(pearson), pair = paste(pair, collapse = "x"))
 }))
}))
```

```{r}
cross_similarity %>%
  group_by(pair, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(window2 >= window1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=window1, y=window2, fill=m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "Pearson's r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"))
```


## Cross-run autocorr

```{r}
run_pairs <- data.frame(
  run1 = sim_id,
  run2 = c(sim_id[-1], sim_id[1])
)

orientation_combs <- expand.grid(
  orientation = orientation_list,
  pair_id = seq_len(nrow(run_pairs))
)

crossrun_degree_similarity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(orientation_combs)), function(row) {

  orientation <- orientation_combs$orientation[row]
  pair_id <- orientation_combs$pair_id[row]

  r1 <- run_pairs$run1[pair_id]
  r2 <- run_pairs$run2[pair_id]

  token1 <- avg_embeddings %>%
    filter(orientation_degrees == orientation, run == r1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(window) %>%
    arrange(window)

  token2 <- avg_embeddings %>%
    filter(orientation_degrees == orientation, run == r2) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(window) %>%
    arrange(window)

  x <- as.matrix(token1 %>% select(all_of(node_id)))
  y <- as.matrix(token2 %>% select(all_of(node_id)))

  # Pearson correlation within each corresponding window
  cors <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) {
    cor(x[i, ], y[i, ], method = "pearson")
  })

  # Store results
  data.frame(
    label = orientation,
    sim1 = r1,
    sim2 = r2,
    window = token1$window,
    cor = cors
  )

}))
```


# Lag

```{r}
autolag <- degree_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "autolag")

crosslag <- cross_similarity %>%
  group_by(pair, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "crosslag")

crossemb <- cross_similarity %>%
  filter(window1==window2) %>%
  select(!window2) %>%
  group_by(pair, window1) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(window1) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(window1>5, window1<=20) %>%
  mutate(diag = row_number()) %>%
  # rename("diag" = "window1") %>%
  mutate(type = "crossemb")

crossrun <- crossrun_degree_similarity %>%
  select(!sim2) %>%
  group_by(window, label) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(window) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename("diag" = window) %>%
  mutate(type = "crossrun")

combined_df <- bind_rows(list(autolag, crosslag, crossemb)) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type,
                       levels = c("autolag", "crossemb", "crosslag"),
                       labels = c("autocorrelation",
                                  "cross-correlation\n(within-window)",
                                  "cross-correlation\n(between-window)")))
```

```{r}
combined_df %>%
  filter(diag <= 15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=diag, y=m, color=type, fill=type)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=m-se, ymax=m+se), alpha=0.2, linetype=0) +
    scale_color_discrete(palette = "dark2") +
    scale_fill_discrete(palette = "dark2") +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks=6) +
    labs(x = "lag / window", y = "Pearson's r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          legend.key.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"))

# ggsave("figures/manuscript/rot_lag.png", bg="white", width=12, height=8)
```


# Heatmaps

```{r}
autohm_df <- token_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rbind(data.frame(window1=c(1:25), window2=c(1:25), m=1)) %>%
  mutate(type = "autocorrelation")

crosshm_df <- cross_similarity %>%
  group_by(pair, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(window2 >= window1)%>%
  mutate(type = "crosscorrelation")
  
rbind(autohm_df, crosshm_df) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=window1, y=window2, fill=m)) +
    facet_wrap(~type) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "Pearson's r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28, margin = margin(b = 15)),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"))

# ggsave("figures/manuscript/rot_heatmaps.png", bg="white", width=20, height=10)
```
